findings.title: Image runs as root but the pod requires non-root
findings.cause: container web must run as a non-root user (runAsNonRoot), but image docker.io/library/busybox:1.37.0@sha256:a7dbc319b1438115a207e11930dc4bb3e643dcb3ec0bdd694bb36cd8fad289ec runs as root; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: container has runAsNonRoot and image will run as root (pod: "web-67f8d9fc9-6f5ph_kd-runasnonroot-root-image(ae8128b7-db16-4a53-b4a8-2cb56147861b)", container: web)

findings.fix: Set securityContext.runAsUser to a non-zero UID the image supports, or use an image built to run as a non-root user.
